entities.summary: Jile Temple of Harbin, China, is the largest Buddhist building complex in Heilongjiang and was constructed between 1921 and 1924. The grounds cover 53,500 square metres and the buildings cover 5,186 square metres. It is located at No. 5 East Dazhi Street, Nangang Dist. in Harbin. The temple was badly damaged in August 1966, during the Cultural Revolution, and later rebuilt.
